source.spec: audit/claude-skills quality audit October 2026, new-skill proposal #2
source.build_pattern: Statistics-first eval gate: 3 deterministic stdlib scripts (trajectory grading, flake detection, paired regression gate) with blocking exit codes. Formulas cited to primary sources: pass@k (Chen et al. 2021), pass^k (Yao et al. 2024, tau-bench), per-question paired differences and resampling (Miller 2024), Wilson interval (NIST), exact McNemar; match-mode names follow LangChain agentevals; outcome-over-path guidance from Anthropic's 'Demystifying evals for AI agents'.
source.distinct_from: prompt-governance (versions and registers prompts; this gates a change with statistics); self-eval (grades one session's work); agenthub eval (ranks parallel agents in one session); skill-tester (validates skill packages, not agent behaviour)
